text.p: Sterling set to keep to tight ranges vs dollar with near-term support at round-figure $1.62 likely to hold in near-term, said analysts.
This level also coincides with the rising resistance line drawn from the mid-March low but Wednesday's brief test below here has lessened the strength of this support.
A move below $1.62 then finds minor support around $1.6190 before testing major support at $1.6155-60, the pound's recent range bottom and April low.
If $1.6160 breaks, analysts said there is little to block the downside until the March low at $1.5850.

"The drop from the $1.6310-40 corrective target provides a window to break down aggressively over the next two to three days to attack the $1.5850 low," said Eddie Matts, director at Capital Management.

Cable gains face minor resistance around the $1.6280 area but tougher barriers lie in the $1.6300-30 region. As well as being round-figure resistance, this area contains trendline resistance around $1.6320 and Wednesday's top at $1.6330.
A break higher then finds resistance at last week's high of $1.6395 and then the psychological $1.64 before retesting the early April peak at $1.6550.
